visualCharacteristics.summary: Service article body container: section head, rich text, fact boxes, icon tiles, text image and CTA, each row typed by its content
visualCharacteristics.purpose: Service article body: a container whose rows are typed by content - section head (eyebrow + h2, also reabsorbed from default content authored before the block), rich text, light-blue quote / dark-blue benefits fact boxes, icon tiles with an optional tile-box headline, full-width text image, and CTA with optional service-time note. Full-bleed section shell with top band and section-end padding. Options: `grey` / `lavender` ground; `band-white` / `band-grey` step band colour (hidden below 768px); `narrow-cta` renders the CTA box at the 50% garage-election width with equal-width actions from 768px; `cta-gap` adds the 30px + 16px gap under the rich text before the CTA
